references.text: God's original instructions to Moses on building the ark (הָאָרֹן) with its poles and the mercy seat (הַכַּפֹּרֶת).
Detailed instructions regarding the mercy seat (הַכַּפֹּרֶת) that was to be placed above the ark.
Instructions concerning the veil (פָּרֹכֶת הַמָּסָךְ) that was to separate the holy place from the Most Holy Place.
Bezalel builds the ark with its poles and the mercy seat in accordance with the instructions.
Moses is told to set up the ark and cover it with the veil.
Moses brings the ark into the tabernacle and hangs the veil to shield it.
The mercy seat (הַכַּפֹּרֶת) is mentioned in connection with the Day of Atonement, where God reveals Himself above it.
Hebrews describes the ark of the covenant and the mercy seat in the Most Holy Place, behind the veil.
Connects the command to make the ark with the atonement cover to the confirmation that the work was carried out exactly according to God's plan.
Links the making of the ark and the veil to their later role as central elements in the Levitical service.
Highlights the transition from the command to make the ark with the atonement cover to its actual assembly and placement in the tent.
Connects the definition of the ark with the atonement cover as the heart of the tabernacle, from the commissioning phase to the construction phase.
Links the command regarding the carrying poles on the ark to the actual execution of the work.
